purpose: Maintain a complete, accurate, plain-language story for a high-school reader while supporting unlimited evidence-backed institutional research depth without forced section counts.

reader.target: approximately grade 10; preserve original technical meaning
reader.defaultProduct: one cohesive full-context paper, not a directory or research to-do list
reader.lead: State the supported answer and why it matters in the first paragraphs.
style: Plain English, define unfamiliar terms when first used.
Use connected paragraphs and informative headings only when they help.
Prefer explainable descriptions over unexplained scores, graphs or acronym lists.
Do not rely on clickable appendices to convey essential facts.
When uncertain, explain what is known and why the evidence is limited without flooding the reader with missing-data prompts.
No invented quotes, source details, funding amounts, incidents or causal relationships.
Present public sources and corrections access without inserting internal logs.
accessibility: clear 44px or larger interaction targets where practical
readable font size and line spacing
plain link names rather than generic tool jargon

research.depthPolicy: Scale to verified complexity, impact and source support, not the page count or number of template headings.

primaryModes.description: Complete subject narrative, relevant local facts, source-backed relationships, outcomes and practical choices.
Crosswalk several organizations or jurisdictions with source-backed authority, roles, money, assets, people and dependencies.
For complex public and private institutions, retain a source-traceable institutional evidence layer alongside the readable main story.

enhancedEntityTriggers: Verified parent/subsidiary or inter-agency hierarchy across levels
Multiple dated jurisdictions, regulators or legal authorities
Material multi-year funding, debt, contract and payment flows
Critical infrastructure, workforce, service or supply-chain responsibilities
Substantive public safety, environmental, civil rights or Child Zero consequences
Documented disputes, investigations, audit findings or conflicting source records
Long historical changes and future dependency risks

entityDimensions.description: Exact legal name, aliases, jurisdiction, business form, public/private/regulated status, history and identity confidence.
Statutory/contractual authority, board/commission, leadership appointments/terms, who can decide and who can overturn.
Major sector → institution → departments, service lines, roles, programs, contractors and source-proven connected organizations; resolve aliases before joining.
What it actually does, who it serves, service area, sites and major physical/digital assets, capacity and measurable performance.
Staffing, work conditions, bargaining if relevant, critical vendors, suppliers and dependent organizations.
Funds by source, annual and multi-year budgets, proposed/awarded/obligated/contracted/invoiced/paid/achieved distinctions, debt, rates, grants and long-life liabilities.
Programs, service delivery, capital projects, materials, maintenance, procurement, lifecycle, standards and measurable outcomes.
Applicable rules and deadlines, regulators, permits, litigation, due process, civil rights and oversight.
People and places served, affected groups, accessible services, children and other vulnerable populations, distribution of benefit and burden.
LL historical transitions, predecessor entities, source versions, comparison years and decisions that shaped the present.
Original evidence ledger, source dates, counterclaims, independent corroboration, audit/court findings and remaining material uncertainties.
Cross-system disruptions, single points of failure, backup independence, human consequences and service recovery.
Feasible RX remedies, accountable owners, costed alternatives, T2Y/EE gates, Twin assumptions and LEAP pathways.

sourceRules: No original-source verification means no assertion of current authority, spending or confirmed consequences.
Source depth must expand for major claims, rather than filling 40 arbitrary headings.
Do not infer parent/child institutions from similar names or historical registry candidates.
Public entity data only; never reveal private personnel, children, patients or congregation membership.
Share the complete available explanation, not a research request list.
LL, Quilt, TTL, Child Zero, T2Y, EE, SHOCK/BACKUP and Twin are analytical lenses, not mandatory headings.
An entity may have no data for a dimension; omit irrelevant/unverified sections from the public paper and keep a short material limitation in narrative.
Any public release remains subject to accountable human approval.

presentation.main: A single rich narrative with paragraph-linked evidence citations; primary content always visible.
presentation.additional: Expanders only for genuinely supported detailed financials, dated entity crosswalks, source tables, source contradictions and technical methods.
presentation.onDemand: If governed source verification is enabled, KOS retrieves/reconciles sources before returning a provisional paper; no unattended publication.
presentation.currentStatus: Design contract and lookup integration only; does not represent an active research AI service.
